title: Attached garage serving a house with a secondary suite: application of Sentence 9.10.9.18.(3)
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 (National Building Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: March 2025 (platform created March 26, 2025, last updated March 26, 2025)

facts.text: The interpretation clarifies the application of Sentence 9.10.9.18.(3) of NBC(AE) to a house with a secondary suite.
Sentence 9.10.9.18.(3) can be applied to a house with a secondary suite, because the attached garage is considered to serve not only the primary dwelling unit but also the secondary suite.
The document also refers to determining whether professional involvement is required for a project.
